text_block_list.text:
One day, upon arriving at the track... I 
saw Gentildonna running hard all by 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Whew…… Now then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...What a run, good grief.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Truly... beyond all measure—

Following Verxina's gaze as she looked 
toward the course rather than at 
Gentildonna――

Right at the starting line, there was a 
massive hole that looked just like a 
crater...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No wonder my legs felt so heavy halfway 
through.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Must've had a clump of dirt stuck to my 
shoe. I still need to study how hard to 
plant my feet.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Even under those conditions, 
maintaining such speed? Truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You were watching, weren't you? However, 
pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate it if you didn't call that 
run "as expected of me" when it was only 
of that level.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, h-hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
――Ngh............nnnnngh!!! 
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

Gentildonna abruptly stepped up to the 
starting line... and dashed through with a 
run even more awe-inspiring than 
before...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Kgh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Being rendered speechless—that is the only 
proper attitude to hold before the truly 
strong.
choice_data_list:
(Her speed and mental fortitude are on a 
whole different level.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...May I run next? In front of you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I do not mind in the slightest. However, I 
must decline any tedious spectacles, 
understood?

Running down a slope as if it were flat 
ground is no easy feat. Yet she mastered 
the downhill gradient, harnessing its 
speed as she charged forward.
choice_data_list: (She isn't just bold... this girl is――)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What might this be?
choice_data_list:
...I was just thinking how well-studied 
your running style is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: To know is the same as to command.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Cultivating knowledge is also the duty of 
the strong. ――Do you understand?
